question: At the same frozen model and saved Adam state, how do TOTAL/KEEP addends from different fixed training probes change the same stop-probe objective?

snapshots.trained_objective: P3 one-step-trained common origin; diagnostic SK and auxiliary objectives are prospective

primary_observation: Per-alpha target common-total loss difference from its same-snapshot stop alpha0; registered finite-style overshoot decision remains secondary.
common_objective: Lone + .1*Lroll + .2*(Lrelative_teacher + .1*Lrelative_free). For C0/common this is hypothetical, not their historical training objective.
held_fixed: same-snapshot original weights and Adam state
target raw total gradient and raw-five reference losses
saved native TOTAL/KEEP source addends and parameter coordinates
CPU float32 model and float64 physical/loss boundary
changed_factor: Source of the already-saved direction, crossed with the unchanged four alpha values. Native direction norms are retained; no normalization, refitting, new gradient or Adam computation.

alpha0_reproduction.components: all five target stop loss terms

neutral_margin: 1e-6*max(1,abs(target_total_at_alpha0)); descriptive numeric tie band, not certified error, CI or effect threshold.
parameter_copy_control: All four evaluated and rounded-displacement arrays must bitwise equal the same-source previous finite assay. Mismatch is hard contract failure.
self_stop_control: Seven self-stop cases must exactly reproduce previous stop teacher/free predictions and all four alpha loss_values/status rows. Compare saved outputs only; no additional replay forwards.
alpha0_negative_control: Within each snapshot, all four sources must exactly reproduce the same prior stop alpha0 predictions/loss values and match each other.

failure_policy.contract_failure: Stop with preserved prefix/failure record; never interpret as model effect or automatically retry.
failure_policy.numeric_or_raw_reference_failure: Retain case and all four alpha slots; all three positive endpoints in that case become NOT_INTERPRETED in cross primary counts.
failure_policy.global_control_failure: Any self-stop or source-alpha0 control mismatch makes analysis HOLD_CONTROL_FAILURE and all primary counts null; preserve raw measurements.
failure_policy.order: Numeric failure first, otherwise raw-reference reproduction failure, then global saved-control gate, then eligible endpoint relations.

primary_counts_schema: all(28 cases/84 positive endpoints),self_stop(7/21),other_sources(21/63),by_source_probe(each7/21), each with by_alpha 0.25/0.5/1.0 counts including NOT_INTERPRETED.
limits: Effects of specified stored addends on overlapping frozen training probes only; direction magnitude differs by source. Not an isolated regime effect, actual historical next-batch replay, whole-training cause, generalization or alignment efficacy.
